title: Line Extension Warranty Terms — Credit on Electric Service by Rate Schedule Seasonal Restores
content:
**Warranty terms.** A member whose Irrigation Well Extension line project was built under Line Extensions and New Service Construction receives a warranty credit off the restore fee when an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is restored, according to how long ago the extension was energized:

| Irrigation Well Extension energized | Credit taken off the restore fee |
|---|---|
| Less than twelve whole months before the current date — its first-season crew visit is covered | $30.00 |
| Twelve to twenty-three whole months before the current date | $15.00 |
| Twenty-four whole months or more before, or no such extension | Nothing |

The credit is taken off the restore fee, which is never less than zero.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical energized dates)

| Whole months since the extension was energized | Credit |
|---|---|
| 11 | $30.00 |
| 12 | $15.00 |
| 23 | $15.00 |
| 24 | Nothing |

### Point of reading

- The extension read is the member's own line extension project of the Irrigation Well Extension type, by its energized date.
